reasoning.step1:
Plan: identify if document is an invoice, locate sender VAT, invoice date, grand total, VAT rate, net amount and VAT amount; verify occurrences and avoid guessing.

1) Document classification
- Header shows company "SENNA Nahrungsmittel GmbH & CoKG" and title "RECHNUNG" (German for Invoice) — confirms invoice.
- No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" prominent. Proceed with extraction.

2) Locate Grand Total
- Near bottom: "Endbetrag ... EUR 34.649,73" and earlier "31.499,75 + 10 % Mehrwertsteuer 3.149,98 Endbetrag EUR 34.649,73".
- Grand total clearly 34.649,73 EUR → numeric value: 34649.73 (preserve decimals).

3) Locate Invoice Date
- Line: "Wien am 25-01-2024" → invoice date string present as "25-01-2024".
- Do not reformat beyond original format.

4) Determine Sender VAT ID
- Two UIDs appear:
  - "Ihre UID: ATU22642807" — phrase "Ihre UID" (your UID) refers to the customer, so this is buyer VAT.
  - "UID-Nr.: ATU 43349701" appears in company info section near bank details and company registration — this corresponds to SENNA (sender).
- Therefore Sender.VatId = "ATU43349701" (remove spaces as in original numeric grouping? Original shows "ATU 43349701" with a space; keep consistent: "ATU43349701" without space).

5) VAT Rate
- Shown as "+ 10 % Mehrwertsteuer" → VAT rate = 10 (per rule: omit % sign).

6) Net Amount and VAT Amount
- Net amount labeled "Auftragssumme 31.499,75" and repeated "31.499,75 + 10 % Mehrwertsteuer 3.149,98" → Net.Amount = 31499.75, Vat.Amount = 3149.98 (preserve decimals).

7) Check No-Inference and multiple occurrences
- All extracted values are explicitly present. No guessing used.
- If any field were missing would be set to "" per rules (not needed here).

Conclusion: fields determined with explicit evidence: Invoice.Date "25-01-2024", GrandTotal.Amount 34649.73, Sender.VatId "ATU43349701", Vat.Rate 10, Net.Amount 31499.75, Vat.Amount 3149.98.
